summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held September 8, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Israel time at the offices of Naschitz, Brandes, Amir & Co. in Tel Aviv. Approximately 72% of outstanding ordinary shares were represented and voted, and all proposals in the proxy statement furnished July 27, 2026, as amended August 24, 2026, were approved by requisite majorities under the Israeli Companies Law, 5759-1999. No special-situation transaction terms, advisor, or risk-arb angle is present.
